title: China’s open-weights AI strategy is winning
summary: This article argues that China is gaining an advantage in AI development through an open-weights strategy, allowing public access to models and weights, while the US is pursuing a more closed and proprietary approach with export restrictions and closed-source models.
problem_solved: Addresses the strategic question of whether open or closed AI development approaches will win in the global AI race.
why_valuable: Provides insight into geopolitical AI competition and raises important questions about the long-term implications of open vs proprietary AI strategies.
